name: topospatial-cad-mcp
description: Architectural CAD and spatial topology intelligence MCP server for AutoCAD.
long_description: TopoSpatial-CAD MCP connects Claude Desktop directly to Autodesk AutoCAD for architectural spatial reasoning, floor plan synthesis, topological graph analysis, bounded BIM ontology, and non-destructive plan modifications.
